The nominative of «Όσιος Ιωάννης του Πολύτλα και εγκλείστου του εν Κιέβω σπηλαίου» in this folder's Greek citation.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 18. јул ст. ст., „Преп. Јован многострадални.“ — „Преп.“ is the rank, which `types` now carries, and „многострадални“ is a **by-name and not a see or a rank**: it is the epithet the folder’s own display name renders «the Long-Suffering», and §6 keeps a by-name. `foldchk.py` returns no holder and `sr-foldpred.mjs` predicts a new key with no other holder — **and the by-name is the whole of what keeps it so**, a bare «Јован» being the commonest forename in this corpus and certain to fold deeper than the nine Vladimirs of 15 July. §6 earning its keep for the fourth time in this range.

Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 31.07.2026 (18. јул ст. ст.) — „Преп. Јован многострадални.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, with its closing full stop, which is what §4 asks for and what `srbody.mjs` now hands back. **THE IDENTIFICATION IS THE BY-NAME, THE CAVE AND THE RELICS HE WAS HEALED BY.** „многострадални“ is this folder’s own «the Long-Suffering», „Затворник у пештери св. Антонија Кијевског“ is the cave of Anthony of Kyiv, and the relics that ended his struggle are those of „св. Мојсеја Угрина (в. 26. јули)“ — **both of those men are folders this one already relates**, and the Russian and Greek rows stand on this very 18 July. **`types` GAINS `venerable` OFF THE HEADING.** „Преп.“ is Преподобни and §5 reads it `venerable`; the folder held `monk` and `ascetic` and not that word, and both of those are earned by the body — a recluse in a cave, and thirty years of struggle. This is the fourth `types` word of this range written off a heading. **`dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THIS BOOK OFFERS NOTHING TO TOUCH THEM WITH.** The folder holds `death` 1155 to 1165, display «c. 1160», `traditional`, and a `birth` whose every field is null with basis `unknown`. This entry gives **no year, no century and no reign** — and the one number in it, the thirty years he was tormented, is a duration, so **there is nothing here that could narrow the recorded interval and nothing is refused**: this is the first folder of the range whose `dates` are untouched because the book is silent rather than because it is refused. `office` stays null. No `locations`: the caves of Kyiv are a narrative. **ONE MISSING RECIPROCAL IS SUPPLIED.** The folder relates `anthony-of-the-caves`; **`anthony-of-the-caves` did not relate it back**, so naming him in this life would have failed the two-way floor. The reciprocal is added to his folder in this same batch, with no row and no other change — **and his folder was upgraded by this same reader eight days earlier, on the Julian 10 July**, so the two writes stand in one range. `moses-the-hungarian` was already two-way and is named and linked as well. **WHAT IS NEW IS THE SHAPE OF THE THIRTY YEARS AND WHAT ENDED THEM.** For thirty years he was tormented by the passion of lust, against which he fought without giving way, until he overcame it by the help of God **and by touching the relics of Moses the Hungarian** — and the book sends the reader to its own 26 July for him, which is in this same range. Having conquered the foul passion, John was **lit from within by heavenly light, by which he could see at night as by day**. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Терпе́ния столп вои́стину непоколеби́мый,/ и забра́ло от вра́жиих стреля́ний необори́мо,/ равноа́нгельне и многострада́льне о́тче наш Иоа́нне,/ иму́ще тя, мы, недосто́йнии, мо́лимся,/ припа́дающе к честны́м твои́м моще́м те́пле,// изба́ви нас душетле́нных страсте́й плотски́х и спаси́ твои́ми моли́твами.

source.text: Азбука веры, месяцеслов (azbyka.ru) — «Иоанн Печерский, Многострадальный», тропарь и кондак

english.text: A pillar of patience truly unshaken, and a rampart against the arrows of the enemy that cannot be stormed, O our father John, equal to the angels and long-suffering: having thee, we the unworthy pray, falling down fervently before thy precious relics, deliver us from the fleshly passions that corrupt the soul, and save us by thy prayers.

hymns.text: Сто́лп целому́дрия, вра́жиими боре́ньми непобеди́мь сый,/ а́ки столп, многострада́льное водруже́нно оста́вил еси́ нам те́ло твое́,/ всече́стне Иоа́нне,/ ему́же в не́мощех душе́вных и теле́сных покланя́ющеся,/ мо́лим тя, преподо́бне:// моли́ Христа́ Бо́га непреста́нно о всех нас.

source.text: Азбука веры, месяцеслов (azbyka.ru) — «Иоанн Печерский, Многострадальный», тропарь и кондак

english.text: A pillar of chastity unconquered by the assaults of the enemy, thou hast left us thy long-suffering body set fast like a pillar, O all-honoured John; and bowing before it in the infirmities of our souls and bodies, we pray thee, O venerable one: entreat Christ God unceasingly for us all.
